# mineleng博客

> 一个初三牲的博客

This is the llms.txt file for mineleng博客. It provides a machine-readable directory of published articles and core pages for Large Language Models.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://mcleng.cn/): Main blog entrance and latest post stream.
- [About](https://mcleng.cn/about/): Author profile, technical stack, and background.
- [Archive](https://mcleng.cn/archive/): Chronological index of all published writings.

## Articles
- [我的第一篇文章](https://mcleng.cn/posts/hello_world/): 显示在文章列表和元数据中的简短摘要。

## Full Text Dump
- [Full Text Archive](https://mcleng.cn/llms-full.txt): Complete, concatenated Markdown content of all public articles for full-context ingestion.
